dedupe_keys.name: ble separate channel fingerprinting and frequency scanned antenna dataset

description: This Cartagena-led research dataset compares Bluetooth fingerprinting using separate advertising channels, conventional monopoles and frequency-scanned leaky-wave antennas. The Zenodo documentation describes a 7 m by 5 m basement area with 130 calibration points on a 0.5 m grid. Four monopoles and two dual-port scanning antennas provide eight recorded ports. Calibration on 21 November 2023 collected 100 samples per point; test campaigns used ten samples per point on eight days extending to day 94, including changes in furniture. Text measurements are packaged in ZIP files, with linked MATLAB scripts producing calibration and test matrices and signal-strength plots. Data access is free under CC BY 4.0; the linked GitHub repository does not identify a code licence. These controlled observations can test how antenna choice, layout and temporal drift affect positioning in a building digital twin, alongside model-vienna-5g-simulators. The small room and deliberately selected campaign days limit extrapolation to continuous operation or other building materials.
